contributing_factors.name: otel-demo/Pod/flagd-869c45cb9d-rsjs7
contributing_factors.reasoning: This flagd Pod is the common upstream of the failing feature-flag calls. Its EventStream is terminated with a server-side deadline, and dependent services report matching stream/evaluation errors; those downstream alerts and frontend GetAds failures are consequences, not separate resource causes.
contributing_factors.evidence: otel_traces_raw.tsv records an ad EventStream client span to flagd:8013 at 2025-12-15 17:31:12.606 with gRPC status 4, followed by the flagd EventStream server span at 17:31:12.608 with gRPC status 4 and message 'stream closed due to server-side timeout' after about 600 seconds. Recommendation and fraud-detection also have failing flagd EventStream spans. Alert snapshots show RequestErrorRate firing for recommendation (from 17:30), fraud-detection (from 17:34), and ad (from 17:35); service metrics include ad ResolveBoolean errors and frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds errors. The flagd Service endpoint resolves to this Pod, so there is no separate endpoint-mismatch resource to add.

contributing_factors.name: otel-demo/Deployment/payment
contributing_factors.reasoning: The payment Deployment's generation-2 rollout is the independent origin of the later payment-path failure: it replaces the previously serving ReplicaSet with a new payment Pod, after which Payment Charge errors propagate to Checkout PlaceOrder and the frontend. Checkout and frontend alerts are downstream symptoms, not additional causes.
contributing_factors.evidence: Object snapshots show payment Deployment generation 1 with the old ReplicaSet ready through 17:43, then generation 2 progressing at 17:48:30; the old ReplicaSet is scaled to zero and the new payment-7b6bfb9fb4-fwlht Pod becomes the payment Service endpoint by 17:48:52. Payment logs show the old Pod's last Charge at 17:48:26 and the new Pod starting at 17:49:41. After the rollout, service_checkout metrics show 59 STATUS_CODE_ERROR calls for both oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder at 17:50:41 (repeated through 18:00); alerts fire for checkout (1.302 at 17:53) and payment (0.044 at 17:54). Checkout logs have 1206 PlaceOrder entries but only 1147 'payment went through' entries, consistent with those failed payment calls.
